# PLAN — ISSUE-210: keep a human-approved plan when re-approving on a base whose policy changed

Re-approving a human-gated issue on a base whose `.swarm/` policy tree changed currently deletes PLAN.md, TEST_PLAN.md and the review. After this change it keeps the plan and test-plan bytes, marks the old human review as superseded, and waits for a fresh `swarm issue review-plan N --approve`. The unchanged-policy carry stays exactly as it is today.

**Shape**: Involved. The fix is one branch in `carryApprovalEvidence`, but it touches the approval-binding path, so it needs negative tests for each way the old review must stop counting.

## What we know
- `internal/lease/carry.go:48-63`, case `st.PolicyTreeDigest != tree`: plan bytes are kept only when `st.PRNumber > 0 && st.ForkRepo == ""`. Every other case reaches `invalidatePRRevisionEvidence` (`manager.go:1915`), which sets `Artifacts = nil`. That is the #196 failure (carry_reason `policy files changed`).
- `ApproveTask` (`manager.go:686-697`) calls `carryApproval` with the old state, so `st.EffectiveGate` is still the old gate. The new `gate` is assigned afterwards (`manager.go:720`). `ApproveTask` has no backend-specific branch, so the github and local backends share this path.
- The stale review already fails `verifyReviewBinding` once `ApprovalTransition == nil`. `reviewBaseMatches` (`carry.go:10-22`) needs the review's base and policy to match the new state, and the tree check is at `manager.go:2141`.
- `RecordHumanReview` (`manager.go:1379-1458`) binds a new review to the current `BaseSHA`/`PolicyDigest`/`PolicyTreeDigest`, replaces the old review artifact in place and clears `CarryReason`.
- `ExecuteWork` phase `all` skips planning when design and test-plan exist and no review was rejected (`engine.go:725-728`). With `VerifyApproval` failing on a human gate, it pauses (`engine.go:830-850`, `PausedForHuman`). The "missing TEST_PLAN.md" error comes only from empty artifacts (`engine.go:1405`).
- `claimBase` refuses human gates before carrying (`claim_base.go:56`), and `ReapproveRebase` is PR-only (`reapprove_rebase.go:32`). The new branch changes neither.
- `TestApprovalCarryForward` (`carry_test.go:18`) uses a human review. Its `descendant` and `repeated carry` subtests cover the unchanged-policy carry. Its `policy edit` subtest currently asserts that artifacts are cleared.
- `issue status` (`internal/cli/status.go:138-160`) never prints `CarryReason`.

## What we're assuming
- If the new base switches the gate to agent or none, clearing as today is right (out of scope). Check: covered by a test row.
- When the changed-paths lookup fails (`policy files changed (changed paths unavailable…)`), clearing as today is right, the same as the PR branch does. Check: the existing `policy paths unavailable` subtest stays as it is.

## Open questions
- None block the work. Whether the reviewer agrees that the existing `policy edit` subtest changes (see Risks) is settled at the review_plan step.

## Design
In the `st.PolicyTreeDigest != tree` case of `carryApprovalEvidence`, after the existing PR branch, add a new branch. It applies when all of these hold:
- `st.PRNumber == 0`
- `st.ForkRepo == ""`
- `st.PRRevision == nil`
- `st.EffectiveGate == contract.GateHuman`
- `st.CarryReason == "policy files changed"`
- `!requireReview`
- `verifyReviewBinding(st, contract.GateHuman) == nil`, checked while `st` still holds the old base and policy. This means only a valid authenticated human approval is kept, so agent verdicts and tampered or legacy reviews still clear.
- `workspace.BaseIsAncestor(old, new)` is true. If it errors or returns false, set `base ancestry could not be verified` / `base not an ancestor` and clear as today.

When all of these hold, the branch does this:
1. `st.ApprovalTransition = nil` and `clearHeadEvidence(st)`. This keeps design, test-plan and review with their bodies unchanged, and drops implementation and validation.
2. Mark the review: `review.Metadata["superseded_by"] = st.CarryReason`. The verdict and body stay unchanged, so `hasRejectedReview` doesn't trigger a re-plan and attestation digests stay valid.
3. Return. `CarryReason` stays `policy files changed`, and `ChangedPolicyPaths` is set.

In `verifyReviewBinding` (`manager.go:2117`), return `ErrApprovalRequired` when `review.Metadata["superseded_by"] != ""`. This is an explicit check on top of the binding mismatch that already rejects the review.

In `ApproveTask`, after `old.EffectiveGate = gate`: if the review is superseded and `gate != contract.GateHuman`, call `invalidatePRRevisionEvidence(old)`. This keeps today's behavior when the new policy changes the gate.

For status, add a helper `lease.SupersededReview(st) (reason string, ok bool)` in `carry.go`. In `internal/cli/status.go`, after the `Approved by` line and only when `ok`, print:
```
Plan: policy files changed
Policy paths: <comma list>            (only if any)
Plan review required: swarm issue review-plan <N> --approve
```

Alternatives I rejected:
- (a) Carrying the human verdict across the policy change. The WorkUnit forbids it.
- (b) Storing the kept plan outside `Artifacts`, for example in `RevisionPlan`. Work, staging and `RecordHumanReview` all read `Artifacts`, so this would add a second path for no benefit.

## Files and symbols
- `internal/lease/carry.go`: new branch in `carryApprovalEvidence`, plus `SupersededReview`.
- `internal/lease/manager.go`: `verifyReviewBinding` rejects superseded reviews; `ApproveTask` clears when the gate changes.
- `internal/cli/status.go`: carry reason and review-plan hint.
- Tests: `internal/lease/carry_test.go`, new `internal/lease/carry_human_policy_test.go`, a new workflow test next to `internal/workflow/split_recommendation_test.go` (reusing its role-spy setup), and a status test in `internal/cli`.
- Docs: `docs/developer.md:465` (re-approval paragraph): add one sentence saying that a human-gated issue without a PR keeps its plan when policy changes and needs `swarm issue review-plan <issue> --approve`.
- Changelog: `changes/unreleased/210-keep-human-plan-on-policy-change.md`.

Call sites that reach the changed function, each checked against the new branch:
- `ApproveTask` (`manager.go:697`): behavior changes as intended.
- `ReapproveRebase` (`reapprove_rebase.go:84`): has a PR, so it's excluded.
- `claimBase` (`claim_base.go:82`): `requireReview=true`, and human gates are refused earlier.

Other code that reads `CarryReason`:
- `rebase_review.go:18`: agent gate only.
- `rebase_projection.go:22`: PR only.
- `rebaseEvidence` (`carry.go:117`): PR revisions only.

## Steps
1. Add the `verifyReviewBinding` check and the `carryApprovalEvidence` branch, then `SupersededReview`.
2. Add the gate-change guard in `ApproveTask`.
3. Add the status output.
4. Write the tests from TEST_PLAN.md. Update only the `policy edit` subtest's expectation (see Risks).
5. Update the docs paragraph and add the changelog fragment. Run `gofmt`, then `make check`.

## Risks / review notes
- AC1 requires the `descendant` subtest to stay unchanged; this plan doesn't touch it. But the `policy edit` subtest of `TestApprovalCarryForward` asserts the old clearing behavior, which this WorkUnit deliberately changes. I plan to narrow that one subtest: it moves to the "keeps plan, review superseded, `VerifyApproval` fails" expectation, and every other subtest and every tamper check stays byte-identical. The reviewer should confirm this reading of "existing approval-binding tests unchanged".
- Follow-ups, not in scope: the same behavior for agent-gated issues, for fork mode, and when changed paths are unavailable.

# TEST_PLAN — ISSUE-210

All lease tests use `testManager` (local tracker). `ApproveTask` and `carryApprovalEvidence` have no backend-specific branch (`manager.go:640-740`), so the github backend runs the same code. The coverage claim for github rests on that shared path; there is no separate GitHub fake.

## AC1: unchanged policy keeps today's carry
- `TestApprovalCarryForward/descendant` and `/repeated carry` (`internal/lease/carry_test.go`) are not modified and must pass.
- Command: `go test ./internal/lease -run 'TestApprovalCarryForward/(descendant|repeated_carry|same_base)$' -race`

## AC2: policy changed, human gate, no PR: plan kept, review superseded, status hint
New table-driven test `TestHumanPlanKeptOnPolicyChange` in `internal/lease/carry_human_policy_test.go`. Setup: plan, test plan and human `APPROVED` review; release; commit `.swarm/rules/new.md`; then `ApproveTask`.
- **kept** row:
  - design and test-plan bodies are byte-equal to the originals;
  - the review still exists with `Metadata["superseded_by"] == "policy files changed"`;
  - implementation and validation are dropped;
  - `CarryReason == "policy files changed"` and `ChangedPolicyPaths` contains `.swarm/rules/new.md`;
  - `ApprovalTransition == nil`;
  - `errors.As(VerifyApproval(st, wu), *HumanPlanApprovalError)`.
- **superseded marker alone rejects** row: copy the state and rebind the review's metadata (`base_sha`, `policy_digest`, `policy_tree_digest`) to the new state, keeping `superseded_by`. `VerifyApproval` must still return `ErrApprovalRequired`.
- The existing `TestApprovalCarryForward/policy edit` subtest changes its expectation to match the kept row. This is the only edit to that test (see PLAN risks).
- Status: a new test in `internal/cli` runs `swarm issue status <N>` against that state. Output contains `Plan: policy files changed`, `Policy paths: .swarm/rules/new.md` and `swarm issue review-plan <N> --approve`. An unchanged-policy state prints none of these lines.
- Command: `go test ./internal/lease ./internal/cli -run 'TestHumanPlanKeptOnPolicyChange|TestApprovalCarryForward|TestStatus' -race`

## AC3: issue work pauses at the gate, then implements on the new base
New test `TestPolicyChangeKeepsHumanPlan` in `internal/workflow`, reusing the role-spy and mock agent setup from `split_recommendation_test.go`:
1. Human gate. Run `ExecuteWork` phase `plan`, then `RecordHumanReview APPROVED`, then release.
2. Commit a policy change and run `ApproveTask`.
3. Run `ExecuteWork` phase `all`. Expect: no error, so no `missing TEST_PLAN.md`; `res.PausedForHuman == true`; spy roles contain neither `planner` nor `developer`; `.swarm/active/PLAN.md` in the worktree equals the kept body.
4. Run `RecordHumanReview APPROVED`. The new review has `base_sha` = new base, `policy_digest` = new `st.PolicyDigest`, `policy_tree_digest` = new tree, and no `superseded_by`. `VerifyApproval == nil`.
5. Run `ExecuteWork` phase `all` again. Spy roles include `developer` and `tester`, the state `BaseSHA` is the new base, and `VerifyApproval` passes.
- Command: `go test ./internal/workflow -run TestPolicyChangeKeepsHumanPlan -race`

## AC4: agent verdicts, ancestry and WorkUnit edits still clear; binding tests unchanged
Additional rows in `TestHumanPlanKeptOnPolicyChange`, each expecting `len(Artifacts)==0` and `VerifyApproval` failing:
- **agent verdict**: the review has `kind=agent` on a human-gated issue. Also assert that an agent review recorded after the kept-plan approve never satisfies `VerifyApproval` under `GateHuman`.
- **nonancestor**: the policy change is committed on an orphan branch; `CarryReason == "base not an ancestor"`.
- **WorkUnit edit**: issue body edited together with the policy change; `CarryReason == "WorkUnit changed"`.
- **gate changes to agent**: the new base's workflow `default_gate` changes to agent; cleared as today.
- **linked PR**: `PRNumber` is set; the existing PR branch behavior applies and there is no `superseded_by`.

Regression: `TestApprovalCarryForward` (apart from `policy edit`, see above), the tamper loop inside it, and `internal/pr` rebase review tests run unmodified.

Full gate:
```
gofmt -s -l .
go vet ./...
go tool staticcheck ./...
go test ./...
make check
```

## Constraint: changelog
- `test -f changes/unreleased/210-keep-human-plan-on-policy-change.md`
